list.name: underlying
list.label: Underlying
list.query: SELECT 'SPX' AS __text, 'SPX' AS __value UNION SELECT DISTINCT underlying AS __text, underlying AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying <> 'SPX' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT 'SPX' AS __text, 'SPX' AS __value UNION SELECT DISTINCT underlying AS __text, underlying AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying <> 'SPX' ORDER BY 1

list.name: trade_id
list.label: Trade
list.query: SELECT to_char(trade_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' #' || id || ' ' || status || ' ' || direction || ' ' || center_strike::text || 'w' || wing_width::text || ' P&L $' || COALESCE(ROUND((pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 2)::text, 'open') AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 250
list.definition: SELECT to_char(trade_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' #' || id || ' ' || status || ' ' || direction || ' ' || center_strike::text || 'w' || wing_width::text || ' P&L $' || COALESCE(ROUND((pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 2)::text, 'open') AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 250

targets.rawSql: SELECT id AS trade_id, underlying, COALESCE(metadata->>'candidate_id', 'primary') AS strategy, trade_date, status, direction, lower_strike::float AS lower_strike, center_strike::float AS center_strike, upper_strike::float AS upper_strike, wing_width, entry_time, exit_time, (entry_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS entry_price, (exit_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS exit_price, (pnl * 100 * quantity)::float AS pnl, (peak_value * 100 * quantity)::float AS peak_value, exit_reason, quantity, (metadata->>'entry_spot')::float AS entry_spot, (metadata->>'vix')::float AS vix, metadata->>'selection_method' AS selection_method, metadata->>'paper_fill_model' AS fill_model, metadata->>'config_hash' AS config_hash, metadata->>'git_sha' AS git_sha, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::float AS entry_observed_mark, COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::float, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::float) AS exit_observed_value, lower_symbol, center_symbol, upper_symbol FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id

WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), spot_path AS (SELECT sp.ts AS time, sp.price::float AS price, 0 AS source_priority FROM spot_prices sp, trade t WHERE sp.underlying = '$underlying' AND sp.ts BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '10 minutes' AND t.end_time + interval '10 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT q.ts AS time, q.spot_price::float AS price, 1 AS source_priority FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q WHERE q.underlying = '$underlying' AND q.trade_id = $trade_id AND q.spot_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT ON (time) time, price AS "$underlying Spot" FROM spot_path ORDER BY time, source_priority

WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time, center_strike, lower_strike + entry_price AS lower_be, upper_strike - entry_price AS upper_be FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), timeline AS (SELECT generate_series(entry_time - interval '10 minutes', end_time + interval '10 minutes', interval '1 minute') AS time, center_strike, lower_be, upper_be FROM trade) SELECT time, center_strike::float AS "Center", lower_be::float AS "Lower BE", upper_be::float AS "Upper BE" FROM timeline ORDER BY time

SELECT t.entry_time AS time, COALESCE(sp.price, q.spot_price, NULLIF(t.metadata->>'entry_spot', '')::numeric)::float AS "Entry" FROM butterfly_trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.entry_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) sp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) q ON TRUE WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.id = $trade_id

SELECT t.exit_time AS time, COALESCE(sp.price, q.spot_price)::float AS "Exit" FROM butterfly_trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.exit_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) sp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) q ON TRUE WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.id = $trade_id AND t.exit_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.ts AS time, (NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Mark", (NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Peak", NULLIF(d.data->>'drawdown_pct', '')::float AS "Drawdown %" FROM decision_log d JOIN butterfly_trades t ON t.id = $trade_id AND t.underlying = '$underlying' WHERE d.underlying = '$underlying' AND d.data->>'trade_id' = '$trade_id' AND d.event_type IN ('profit_state_transition', 'exit_signal_fired', 'trade_exited') ORDER BY d.ts

SELECT d.ts AS time, d.event_type, COALESCE(d.data->>'from', '') AS from_state, COALESCE(d.data->>'to', '') AS to_state, COALESCE(d.data->>'reason', d.data->>'exit_reason', '') AS reason, (NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS mark_value, (NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS peak_value, NULLIF(d.data->>'drawdown_pct', '')::float AS drawdown_pct, (NULLIF(d.data->>'pnl', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS pnl FROM decision_log d JOIN butterfly_trades t ON t.id = $trade_id AND t.underlying = '$underlying' WHERE d.underlying = '$underlying' AND d.data->>'trade_id' = '$trade_id' AND d.event_type IN ('profit_state_transition', 'exit_signal_fired', 'trade_exited', 'exit_order_failed') ORDER BY d.ts

WITH trade AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), payload AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata->'entry_attempts', 'null'::jsonb), dl.data->'entry_attempts', '[]'::jsonb) AS attempts, t.quantity FROM trade t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = t.underlying AND event_type = 'entry_ladder_trace' AND data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dl ON TRUE) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e->>'step', '')::int, ord - 1) AS step, (NULLIF(e->>'limit', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS limit, (NULLIF(e->>'bid', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS bid, (NULLIF(e->>'mark', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS mark, (NULLIF(e->>'ask', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS ask, NULLIF(e->>'center', '')::float AS center, NULLIF(e->>'width', '')::int AS width, NULLIF(e->>'reward_risk', '')::float AS reward_risk FROM payload, jsonb_array_elements(attempts) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(e, ord) ORDER BY step

WITH trade AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), payload AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata->'exit_ladder_steps', 'null'::jsonb), dl.data->'exit_ladder_steps', '[]'::jsonb) AS steps, t.quantity FROM trade t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = t.underlying AND event_type = 'exit_ladder_trace' AND data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dl ON TRUE) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e->>'step', '')::int, ord - 1) AS step, (NULLIF(e->>'limit', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS limit, (NULLIF(e->>'bid', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS bid, (NULLIF(e->>'mark', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS mark, (NULLIF(e->>'ask', '')::float * 100 * quantity) AS ask, COALESCE(NULLIF(e->>'filled', '')::boolean, false) AS filled FROM payload, jsonb_array_elements(steps) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(e, ord) ORDER BY step

WITH trade AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT c.scan_time AS time, c.direction, c.wing_width AS width, c.center_strike::float AS center, c.lower_strike::float AS lower_strike, c.upper_strike::float AS upper_strike, (c.cost * 100)::float AS cost, (c.max_profit * 100)::float AS max_profit, c.reward_risk::float AS reward_risk, c.lower_be::float AS lower_be, c.upper_be::float AS upper_be, c.distance_from_spot::float AS distance_from_spot, c.spot_price::float AS spot_price, (c.selected OR (c.center_strike = t.center_strike AND c.wing_width = t.wing_width AND c.direction = t.direction)) AS selected_match FROM butterfly_candidates c JOIN trade t ON c.underlying = t.underlying WHERE c.scan_time BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '10 minutes' AND t.entry_time + interval '5 minutes' AND c.direction = t.direction ORDER BY selected_match DESC, c.scan_time DESC, c.reward_risk DESC LIMIT 100

WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time, quantity FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT d.ts AS time, d.event_type, CASE d.event_type WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN 'fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'cost', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' width=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'width', '?') || ' center=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'center', '?') || ' direction=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'direction', '?') WHEN 'entry_ladder_trace' THEN 'entry attempts=' || COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(d.data->'entry_attempts')::text, '0') || ' method=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'selection_method', '?') WHEN 'profit_state_transition' THEN COALESCE(d.data->>'from', 'null') || ' -> ' || COALESCE(d.data->>'to', '?') || ' mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') WHEN 'exit_signal_fired' THEN 'reason=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'reason', '?') || ' mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' drawdown=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'drawdown_pct', '?') || '%' WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN 'reason=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'exit_reason', '?') || ' fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'fill_price', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' pnl=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'pnl', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') WHEN 'exit_ladder_trace' THEN 'exit steps=' || COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(d.data->'exit_ladder_steps')::text, '0') || ' forced=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'forced', 'false') ELSE d.data::text END AS details, d.data::text AS raw_json FROM decision_log d CROSS JOIN trade t WHERE d.underlying = '$underlying' AND ((d.data->>'trade_id') = '$trade_id' OR (d.ts BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '10 minutes' AND t.end_time + interval '10 minutes' AND d.event_type IN ('entry_blocked', 'gap_regime_skip', 'bias_filter_no_signal', 'no_candidates', 'entry_step_unfilled', 'entry_exhausted'))) ORDER BY d.ts

panels.title: Candidate Strategy Review
panels.description: Optional mark_v1 cohort and evidence checks for the strategy selected above. The primary SPX trade view remains unchanged while this row is collapsed.

panels.title: Mark-v1 Cohort Scorecard
panels.description: Closed canonical mark_v1 trades for the selected strategy and underlying. Largest-winner share is relative to gross winning P&L.

targets.rawSql: WITH closed AS (SELECT pnl * 100 * quantity AS pnl_dollars FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND status = 'CLOSED' AND metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1'), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_trades, COALESCE(SUM(pnl_dollars), 0) AS total_pnl, COALESCE(AVG(pnl_dollars), 0) AS average_pnl, COALESCE(AVG((pnl_dollars > 0)::int), 0) AS win_rate, COALESCE(SUM(pnl_dollars) FILTER (WHERE pnl_dollars > 0), 0) AS gross_profit, ABS(COALESCE(SUM(pnl_dollars) FILTER (WHERE pnl_dollars < 0), 0)) AS gross_loss, COALESCE(MAX(pnl_dollars) FILTER (WHERE pnl_dollars > 0), 0) AS largest_winner FROM closed) SELECT closed_trades, total_pnl, average_pnl, win_rate, CASE WHEN gross_loss > 0 THEN gross_profit / gross_loss WHEN gross_profit > 0 THEN 999 ELSE 0 END AS profit_factor, CASE WHEN gross_profit > 0 THEN largest_winner / gross_profit ELSE 0 END AS largest_winner_share, total_pnl - largest_winner AS pnl_without_largest_winner FROM totals

panels.title: Promotion Gate Failures
panels.description: Any nonzero data-quality, strategy-parity, or fill-accounting count requires investigation before candidate promotion.

targets.rawSql: WITH decision_failures AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('entry_feed_blocked', 'position_feed_blocked', 'entry_data_blocked', 'settlement_feed_blocked', 'settlement_failed')) AS data_quality_failures, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_type = 'entry_selection_parity' AND (data->>'available' = 'false' OR data->>'width_match' = 'false' OR data->>'center_match' = 'false')) OR (event_type = 'exit_mark_parity' AND (data->>'available' = 'false' OR data->>'replay_would_miss_drawdown' = 'true'))) AS strategy_parity_failures FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = '$underlying'), fill_failures AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS fill_accounting_failures FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1' AND (NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision IS NULL OR ABS(entry_price - NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision) > 0.0001 OR (status = 'CLOSED' AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision) IS NULL OR ABS(exit_price - COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision)) > 0.0001)))) SELECT data_quality_failures, strategy_parity_failures, fill_accounting_failures FROM decision_failures CROSS JOIN fill_failures

panels.title: Selected Trade Monitoring Values
panels.description: Per-poll butterfly mark, peak, and drawdown for only the selected trade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q.ts AS time, (MAX(q.fly_mark) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Mark", (MAX(q.peak_value) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Peak", MAX(q.drawdown_pct)::float AS "Drawdown %" FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q JOIN butterfly_trades t ON t.underlying = q.underlying AND t.id = q.trade_id WHERE q.underlying = '$underlying' AND q.trade_id = $trade_id AND t.metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1' GROUP BY q.ts, t.quantity ORDER BY q.ts

panels.title: Selected Trade Leg Marks
panels.description: Recorded mark prices for only the selected trade's three option legs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, mark, COALESCE(symbol, strike::text || ' ' || option_type) AS metric FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Selected Trade Fill Accounting
panels.description: The stored mark_v1 entry and exit values should match their recorded execution evidence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id AS trade_id, metadata->>'paper_fill_model' AS fill_model, entry_price, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision AS entry_observed_mark, entry_price - NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision AS entry_variance, exit_price, COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision) AS exit_observed_value, exit_price - COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision) AS exit_variance FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id AND metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1'
